source.license_policy: Directly contributed GNPS reference spectra default to CC0; exclude third-party imported and propagated/MassQL/suspect libraries.
source.eligibility: Source-classified standard spectra; MS2, ESI evidenced in source/instrument annotation; supported adduct and matching mode; connected valid molecular structure, 150-1170 Da, precursor error <=20 ppm, at least five finite positive ordered peaks; reject explicit low-quality or inferred/synthetic acquisition annotations. Preserve raw record hash, original metadata and source URL. GNPS2 snapshot-relative record IDs are derived hashes, not claimed official accessions.

scope: Source preparation only; CASMI overlap and external independence not yet established
